Northwind Labs: Software Engineer Intern, Backend (Summer 2027)

About the role
Northwind Labs builds real-time data infrastructure for logistics companies. As a backend intern you will work on the services that ingest and process millions of shipment events a day.

What you'll do
- Design and build backend services in Java or Go that process streaming data with Kafka
- Write and optimize SQL queries against PostgreSQL
- Containerize services with Docker and deploy them on Kubernetes in AWS
- Participate in code reviews and help debug production issues
- Improve the reliability and observability of our pipelines with Prometheus and Grafana

Basic qualifications
- Currently pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field
- Experience with at least one of Java, Go, or Python
- Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems
- Familiarity with REST APIs and relational databases

Preferred qualifications
- Experience with stream processing (Apache Flink or Spark Streaming)
- Experience with Scala or Cassandra
- Contributions to open source projects
- Experience with CI/CD (GitHub Actions)

Location: Seattle, WA (hybrid)
